finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It now takes either.

`[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on `undefined`. The new loader leaves unset flags unset. It now reads as `false`.

The 8 remaining warnings are deprecations. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is flagged for removal before v5. Worth a look next.
